reward.name: Charm of Sparks
entries: You can cast {@spell Glitter Burst|TST} (level 3 version) or {@spell Dim Lantern|TST} once. The charm then fades.

reward.name: Charm of Embers
entries: This charm has 3 charges. You can expend them to cast {@spell Glitter Burst|TST} (2 charges) or {@spell Dim Lantern|TST} (1 charge). Once all its charges are spent, the charm vanishes.

reward.name: Blessing of the Crowd
entries: You can cast {@spell Dim Lantern|TST} a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once) per {@variantrule Long Rest|TST}.
